reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I actually have a reason, and $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is a risk I can take once. At $29.99 I would probably just grab a cheaper bottle.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. I am not paying full price every month on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: A regular price under $25, or a launch price that stays for a second box.
